bootstrap.repositories: union of task-suite repositories and quality-corpus repositories
bootstrap.exclusion_rule: Exclude a repository from arm execution when its exact pin or initial Twin cannot be established; report runner or inventory absence as unavailable rather than silently excluding it.

screening.comparison: paired active versus ablation(X) cells at identical task, tier and repetition

effect_threshold.primary: at least 2 more objective PASS outcomes for active than ablation(X)
effect_threshold.critical_override: proceed when ablation introduces any completion-correctness or unsafe-claim failure absent from active
effect_threshold.interpretation: candidate selection for B0b only; never promotion or demotion evidence

screening.tier_rationale: The wide screen uses the permitted port-8090 practical-local route for every capability so it remains schedulable and tests the bounded-evidence claim. Full native/off baselines still cover every available tier, including both required GitHub Copilot frontier routes.

baseline.unavailable_policy: retain and report cells as UNAVAILABLE
baseline.frontier_policy: Sonnet and Codex run only through GitHub Copilot registered in ControlDeck-managed OpenCode
